Anonymous route: fresh one-day Developer Edition scratch org; six running-user LocaleSidKey values, LanguageLocaleKey en_US. seed.apex and query.apex were run at API 62.0 and 67.0 after updating the running user locale in a separate transaction. The org was deleted; a subsequent display returned not found.
IsTest route: a second fresh one-day Developer Edition scratch org; LocaleCapture62 and LocaleCapture67 are the deployed source and metadata. Each of six methods creates a synthetic user with LanguageLocaleKey en_US and the indicated LocaleSidKey; System.runAs inserts the same 35 records and queries the same fields and order. Intentional assertion failures report the observed locale and ordered labels. Class metadata API versions are 62.0 and 67.0 respectively; the test-run request used the CLI default API version. All 12 results match their corresponding anonymous rows. The org was deleted; a subsequent display returned not found.
Both routes order BillingCity ASC NULLS FIRST, AccountNumber ASC. org.tsv records route, locale, API and ordered labels.
